Format: Daggerheart Domain Cards TXT v1

Name: A Soldier’s Bond
Type: Ability
Domain: Blade
Recall Cost: 1
Level: 2
Description: <p class="Body-Foundation">Once per long rest\, when you compliment someone or ask them about something they’re good at\, you can both gain 3 Hope.</p>

---

Name: Adjust Reality
Type: Spell
Domain: Arcana
Recall Cost: 1
Level: 10
Description: <p class="Body-Foundation">After you or a willing ally make any roll\, you can <strong>spend 5 </strong><strong>Hope</strong> to change the numerical result of that roll to a result of your choice instead. The result must be plausible within the range of the dice.        </p>

---

Name: Arcana-Touched
Type: Ability
Domain: Arcana
Recall Cost: 2
Level: 7
Description: <p class="Body-Foundation">When 4 or more of the domain cards in your loadout are from the Arcana domain\, gain the following benefits:</p><ul class=""><li class="vertical-card-list-found">+1 bonus to your Spellcast Rolls</li><li class="vertical-card-list-found">Once per rest\, you can switch the results of your Hope and Fear Dice.</li></ul>

---

Name: Arcane Reflection
Type: Spell
Domain: Arcana
Recall Cost: 1
Level: 8
Description: <p class="Body-Foundation">When you would take magic damage\, you can <strong>spend any number of </strong><strong>Hope</strong> to roll that many <strong>d6s</strong>. If any roll a 6\, the attack is reflected back to the caster\, dealing the damage to them instead.        </p>

---

Name: Armorer
Type: Ability
Domain: Valor
Recall Cost: 1
Level: 5
Description: <p class="Body-Foundation">While you’re wearing armor\, gain a +1 bonus to your Armor Score.</p><p class="Body-Foundation">During a rest\, when you choose to repair your armor as a downtime move\, your allies also clear an Armor Slot.</p>

---

Name: Astral Projection
Type: Spell
Domain: Grace
Recall Cost: 0
Level: 8
Description: <p class="Body-Foundation">Once per long rest\, <strong>mark a </strong><strong>Stress</strong> to create a projected copy of yourself that can appear anywhere you’ve been before.        </p><p class="Body-Foundation">You can see and hear through the projection as though it were you and affect the world as though you were there. A creature investigating the projection can tell it’s of magical origin. This effect lasts until your next rest or your projection takes any damage.</p>

---

Name: Avatar of Terror
Type: Spell
Domain: Dread
Recall Cost: 2
Level: 10
Description: <p class="Body-Foundation ParaOverride-3"><strong>Mark a Stress</strong> to transform into a creature fueled by fear. While in this form\, you gain a <strong>1d6</strong> bonus to your damage rolls for each Fear in the GM’s pool. Additionally\, you gain a Hope when the GM spends a Fear to spotlight an adversary within Very Close range.</p><p class="Body-Foundation">Before you make an action roll\, you must spend a Hope. If you can’t\, you revert to your normal form.</p>

---

Name: Banish
Type: Spell
Domain: Codex
Recall Cost: 0
Level: 6
Description: <p class="Body-Foundation">Make a <strong>Spellcast Roll</strong> against a target within Close range. On a success\, roll a number of <strong>d20</strong>s equal to your Spellcast trait. The target must make a reaction roll with a Difficulty equal to your highest result. On a success\, the target must mark a Stress but isn’t banished. Once per rest on a failure\, they are banished from this realm. </p><p class="Body-Foundation">When the PCs roll with Fear\, the Difficulty gains a −1 penalty and the target makes another reaction roll. On a success\, they return from banishment.</p>

---

Name: Bare Bones
Type: Ability
Domain: Valor
Recall Cost: 0
Level: 1
Description: <p class="Body-Foundation">When you choose not to equip armor\, you have a base Armor Score of 3 + your Strength and use the following as your base damage thresholds:</p><ul class=""><li class="vertical-card-list-found"><em><strong>Tier 1:</strong></em> 9/19</li><li class="vertical-card-list-found"><em><strong>Tier 2:</strong></em> 11/24</li><li class="vertical-card-list-found"><em><strong>Tier 3:</strong></em> 13/31</li><li class="vertical-card-list-found"><em><strong>Tier 4:</strong></em> 15/38</li></ul>

Name: Battle Cry
Type: Ability
Domain: Blade
Recall Cost: 2
Level: 8
Description: <p class="Body-Foundation">Once per long rest\, while you’re charging into danger\, you can muster a rousing call that inspires your allies. All allies who can hear you each clear a Stress and gain a Hope. Additionally\, your allies gain advantage on attack rolls until you or an ally rolls a failure with Fear.</p>

Type: Ability
Domain: Blade
Recall Cost: 0
Level: 10
Description: <p class="Body-Foundation">When you make a successful attack against an adversary\, you can <strong>mark 4 </strong><strong>Stress</strong> to force the target to mark a number of Hit Points equal to the number of Hit Points you currently have marked instead of rolling for damage.        </p>

Name: Blighting Strike
Type: Spell
Domain: Dread
Recall Cost: 1
Level: 1
Description: <p class="Body-Foundation-No-BOLDITALIC">Make a <strong>Spellcast Roll</strong> against a target within Far range. On a success:</p><ul class=""><li class="vertical-card-list">On a roll with Hope\, deal <strong>d6+1</strong> magic damage using your Proficiency. On a roll with Fear\, deal <strong>d10+1</strong> magic damage using your Proficiency.</li><li class="vertical-card-list">The target’s next successful attack deals half damage.</li></ul><p class="Body-Foundation-No-BOLDITALIC">On a failure\, you must spend a Hope or mark a Stress.</p>

Name: Blink Out
Type: Spell
Domain: Arcana
Recall Cost: 1
Level: 4
Description: <p class="Body-Foundation">Make a <strong>Spellcast Roll</strong><strong> (12)</strong>. On a success\, <strong>spend a </strong><strong>Hope</strong> to teleport to another point you can see within Far range. If any willing creatures are within Very Close range\, <strong>spend an additional Hope</strong> for each creature to bring them with you.        </p>

---

Name: Blood Bind
Type: Spell
Domain: Blood
Recall Cost: 2
Level: 6
Description: <p class="Body">Make a <strong>Spellcast Roll</strong> against a target within Far range. On a success\, <strong>mark a Stress</strong> as you slow the target’s vitality. The target is temporarily <strong>Restrained</strong> and temporarily <strong>Vulnerable</strong>. Each time the target is spotlighted while either of these conditions persists on them\, the target takes <strong>d10</strong> magic damage using your Proficiency. The spell ends early on the target if you use it again.</p>

---

Name: Blood Puppet
Type: Spell
Domain: Blood
Recall Cost: 2
Level: 3
Description: <p class="Body">Make a <strong>Spellcast Roll</strong> against a creature (living or dead) within Far range. On a success\, <strong>spend a Hope</strong> to control the target by causing them to move\, attack\, or both. If you do both\, you choose the order. If you cause the creature to move\, they move to a location you choose that’s within Close range of them. If you cause the creature to attack\, make a <strong>Spellcast Roll</strong> against a target within Melee range of them. On a success\, deal <strong>d10</strong> physical damage using your Proficiency.</p>

---

Name: Blood Spike
Type: Spell
Domain: Blood
Recall Cost: 1
Level: 1
Description: <p class="Body">Make a <strong>Spellcast Roll</strong> against a target within Far range. On a success\, <strong>mark a Stress</strong> to deal <strong>d10</strong> magic damage to the target using your Proficiency. On a success with Hope\, the target also marks a Stress. On a roll with Fear\, <strong>mark a Stress</strong>.</p>

On a failure\, a target marks a Stress.</p><p class="Body">Each ally within Close range marks a Stress but clears a Hit Point.</p>

Type: Grimoire
Domain: Codex
Recall Cost: 3
Level: 4
Description: <p class="Card-Feature"><em><strong>Repudiate:</strong></em> You can interrupt a magical effect taking place. Make a reaction roll using your Spellcast trait. Make a <strong>Spellcast Roll</strong> to command them to take action. When necessary\, they share your Evasion and traits and their attacks deal <strong>2d10+3</strong> physical damage. You can only maintain one construct at a time\, and they fall apart when they take any amount of damage.        </p>

All creatures in its path must choose a side to be on\, and anything that subsequently passes through the wall takes <strong>4d10+3</strong> magic damage. </p>

You have advantage on action rolls to de-escalate violent situations or convince someone to follow your lead.</p><p class="Body-Foundation">Additionally\, you’re emboldened in moments of duress. When all of your Stress slots are marked\, you gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency for damage rolls.</p>

Name: Zone of Protection
Type: Spell
Domain: Splendor
Recall Cost: 2
Level: 6
Description: <p class="Body-Foundation">Make a <strong>Spellcast Roll</strong><strong> (16)</strong>. Once per long rest on a success\, choose a point within Far range and create a visible zone of protection there for all allies within Very Close range of that point. When you do\, place a <strong>d6</strong> on this card with the 1 value facing up. When an ally in this zone takes damage\, they reduce it by the die’s value. You then increase the die’s value by one. When the die’s value would exceed 6\, this effect ends.</p>
